correctness.rationale: The signed-antichain convex hull has maximal-chain signed facets; reflections force a zero-centered diagonal unique John ellipsoid. For u_i equal to squared semiaxes, containment is exactly sum_{i∈C}u_i≤1. A maximum antichain intersects every chain at most once, hence u=w/n on it and (n-w)/(n(h−1)) elsewhere is feasible by n≤hw. Multiplication of semiaxes gives the stated binary relative entropy, strictly positive when n<hw. For n=hw Dilworth partitions into w longest h-chains and AM–GM proves max product h^(−n). For layered ordinal sums, symmetry and weighted AM–GM give exact u=m_j/n. Independent exact arithmetic for layers (3,1) gives 3/4,1/4, determinant gain 27/16 over the radius 1/√2 ball; finite case is corroboration not proof.

final_claim: For every finite poset of height h≥2, width w, the standard-coordinate John ellipsoid of the enriched chain polytope has volume at least exp((n/2)D(w/n||1/h)) times the largest inscribed Euclidean ball; equality on stated layered posets, and the John ellipsoid is round exactly when n=h*w.
limitations: Canonical coordinate Euclidean geometry only; full John semiaxis spectrum is not classified for arbitrary posets.
Independent finite example (3,1) does not establish the universal inequality.
